description: Defines a templated expiring cache class with expiration policies, eviction handling, and iteration support, used within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: NoopEvictionHandler
classes.description: A default eviction handler that performs no action upon eviction.

classes.name: ExpiringCache
classes.description: A cache class that stores key-value pairs with expiration policies, supporting eviction, iteration, and size management.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the value associated with a key if it is valid at the given time.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair with expiration information.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: max_entries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of entries allowed in the cache.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the cache is empty.
